_comment: Round 5, main 1, land drop made, Unpredictable Cyclone out, five untapped lands (Watery Grave, 4 Island),
opponent at 15. Hand: Toxic Deluge, Remand. Library top: Street Wraith, Island, Emrakul. Toxic Deluge is
goldfish_inert (never cast on its own). As a REMAND-ONLY target (ceiling 3 + MTG_CYCLONE_REMAND_INERT=1):
cast Deluge ({2}{B}, X = 0 life), Remand it ({1}{U}) -- Deluge back to hand, Remand draws the Wraith; cycle it
(2 life) -> the walk casts Emrakul free -> extra turn, 15 in the air: round 5.
Ceiling 3 with the switch OFF ('3 without Deluge'): Deluge stays a dead card,
nothing draws this turn, the Wraith comes with round 6's draw -> round 6. (Ceiling 1, the shipped default, likewise.)
